snippet.title: Legends of Hearts - Official Steam Wishlist Trailer | Co-op Puzzle Platformer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam Now! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5203690/Legends_of_Hearts/

Grab your buddy and prepare to test your communication skills! Legends of Hearts is an upcoming co-op puzzle platformer where coordination is everything. Solve intricate puzzles, bypass deadly traps, and synchronize your movements to survive.

A journey about friendship, trust, and flawless timing awaits. Will your bond survive the trial? 

FEATURES:

Pure Co-op Gameplay: Designed from the ground up for two players.
Mind-Bending Puzzles: Coordinate switches, timing windows, and physics challenges.
Challenging Platforming: Precision movement required, don't let your partner down!

SUPPORT THE DEV TEAM:

Hit SUBSCRIBE for development updates and beta key announcements!Drop a comment below: Who are you carrying through these levels?
